header: added 12 Nov 2026 after the join of the raw variance, by decision of the lead, who had seen no result; every test of this pass is a reading not fixed in advance
statement: Exploratory and post hoc: the result is a candidate at most and changes no registered reading, flag or decision.
what_this_file_is: The list of the tests of a second pass, on the signal variance, written and committed before anything was computed on the signal variance for this pass. No test of the first pass (tests_enumerated.json, committed at daefc84ee05bddcf58711528f31a6fdf1ad3facf) is changed, added or dropped. The plan's 'measured gradient variance ... as the post-run reviews already fixed them' allows both the raw variance and the signal variance (raw minus shot variance, the quantity the pipeline's compare_points sets against the prediction); both are reported.
what_the_worker_had_seen: This file was written by the worker who made the first pass. That worker had seen the figures the post-run reviews print (raw and signal) and the opening section of the first pass's report. The first pass's script had already formed ln(signal / prediction) per point as a column without any test; its values were not read, only the count of points for which it is undefined. The decision to make this pass, its tests and its exclusion rule were given by the lead, who had seen no result; the points marked as at the shot floor were taken from the wording of the reviews, listed below with file and line, not from any value of r.

rules_of_this_pass.r_signal: r_signal = ln(signal variance / dispatch-time prediction). Signal variance of a point = its measured value of the first pass (the raw variance exactly as joined there, column 'measured' of joined_points.csv, unchanged) minus the registered shot variance of the point: the mean over the point's draws of the per-draw shot variance (loader._shot_var: (std_plus^2 + std_minus^2) / 4 from the Estimator's reported std, else the analytic two-term form) at resilience levels 0 and 1, and 4 x 1/(2N) at level 2 (estimators.level2_shot_variance). The prediction is the same row as in the first pass.
rules_of_this_pass.check: Where the review prints a signal figure for the point (review_figures_signal.csv, each with file and line), the signal variance is compared with it and the comparison is recorded; the value is not replaced.
rules_of_this_pass.points_without_r_signal: Left out of this pass and listed with the reason: (1) the points left out of the first pass; (2) every point the post-run review of its list marks as at the shot floor, by the reviews' own wording (shot_floor_marks): every point with L = 12 of the lists paper1_day1_null_grid_n20 and paper1_day2_main_grid, and no other point; (3) every other point whose signal variance is not a positive finite number. Rule (2) is applied from the marking, not from the size of any r; rule (3) from the sign of the signal variance alone.
rules_of_this_pass.everything_else: Seeds, permutation mechanics, exact enumeration limit, two-sided counting, rules for a test that cannot be formed, the left-out job, day labels and the rule on s are those of tests_enumerated.json. Exact enumeration is over the points actually in the test. A test that cannot be formed enters the family with p = 1 and the reason.
rules_of_this_pass.primary: The primary test of the analysis stays PRIMARY of the first pass (raw variance). PRIMARY.signal and the readings of it are readings not fixed in advance; the report states the sentence of plan Section 5 for them beside the others.
rules_of_this_pass.family: Benjamini-Yekutieli at 10 percent over the union of both passes: N = 274 tests (137 + 137), c(N) = 6.192167. The first-pass-only family (N = 137) is recomputed unchanged and kept beside it; both are labelled.
rules_of_this_pass.not_a_test_of_the_family: For the 39 day-2 points whose measured value is the figure printed in the review (variance with divisor M), both passes are repeated with the registered estimate (divisor M - 1) in its place, and the report says whether any outcome differs (the primary test and its readings at 0.05; the rejections of each family). This repetition enters no family.

known_limits: The smallest Benjamini-Yekutieli threshold of the union is 0.10 / (N * c(N)) = 5.894e-05, below the smallest Monte Carlo p (1/10001); a rejection in the union then needs several small p values together or an exact or parametric test.
This pass was added after the raw-variance pass was complete; it cannot be read as fixed in advance.
